content:
Hello Community,
We're excited to share the intake form for our new initiative: The Dataverse Quarterly Newsletter!

Newsletter Intake Form

That's right! Every quarter, we plan to highlight our community stories, and we need your help to make this a success. We need your stories, photos, and voices!

The first newsletter is scheduled to be mailed right before the Holiday break in December, so let's get typing! Please complete the form at your earliest convenience, but no later than November 30th to be considered for the December edition!

Once we select your submission, we will reach out for photos, credits, etc.

Let's make the first Newsletter epic -

  • The links, etc should work fine, but ping me here if you see any problems

Thank you, Community!!
:holiday_tree:
Sonia
